title: Treatment Visit Billing, Progress Reports and Late Cancellations — Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services
content:
Billing rules for treatment visits and evaluations under **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services**.

## 1. Rule

> Timed minutes on a date convert to units by the eight-minute rule, with fewer than the unit minimum producing no billable unit; one visit per discipline per day is billed, a co-treated session splits its units between the disciplines, and a group session is billed once per resident. Visits are billed only while the plan is active. A progress report is due after each progress report interval of visits; visits after an overdue report, and visits outside a signed current plan, are not billable to anyone. No Part B therapy is billed for a day the resident is in a Part A covered stay, because therapy is part of the Part A per diem. A late cancellation is recorded only for a private-pay visit cancelled with less than the late cancel notice hours or missed.

## 2. Units

2.1 A timed unit is 15 minutes, and the unit minimum is 8 total timed minutes, in every tier.

2.2 Under the eight-minute rule, 8 to 22 minutes make one unit, 23 to 37 minutes two units, and each further 15 minutes one more unit. Fewer than 8 minutes produce no billable unit.

2.3 One visit per discipline per day is billed (1 billable treatment visit per discipline per day). A co-treated session, in which two disciplines treat together, splits its units between the disciplines. A group session is billed once per resident.

| Hypothetical total timed minutes on a date | Billable units |
|---|---|
| 6 | None |
| 19 | 1 |
| 31 | 2 |
| 49 | 3 |

## 3. The plan must be active

Visits are billed only while the plan is active. This is judged on the system's record of the status of the plan the visit is claimed on, as it stands before the visit is billed. A plan that is referred, on hold, discharged, closed or not indicated is not active.

## 4. Progress reports

4.1 A progress report is due after each 10 visits. The visits are counted as the treatment service dates on the plan from the day after the plan's latest progress report (or its certification date) to the visit date. A completed progress report is recorded with its report date and the visits it covers since the last report.

4.2 Visits after an overdue progress report are not billable to anyone; nor are visits outside a signed, current plan of care.

Hypothetical case: a plan certified with no progress report since has had visits on 10 service dates. A progress report is due. A further visit on an 11th service date, with the report still not completed, is a visit after an overdue report and is not billable to anyone.

## 5. Days in a Part A covered stay

No Part B therapy is billed for a day the resident is in a Part A covered stay; therapy on that day is part of the Part A per diem.

## 6. Late cancellations

A late cancellation is recorded only for a private-pay visit cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice, or missed. It is recorded once per scheduled visit date.

| Hypothetical scheduled visit | Late cancellation recorded |
|---|---|
| Private-pay visit cancelled with 14 hours' notice | Yes |
| Private-pay visit cancelled with exactly 24 hours' notice | No (not less than 24 hours) |
| Private-pay visit missed | Yes |
| Medicare Part B visit cancelled with 14 hours' notice | No (not a private-pay visit) |

## 7. What a visit record holds

Each visit is recorded per plan, service date and procedure, with the total timed minutes, the billable units, the payer allowed amount for the line, whether the KX modifier was attached, and the claim date.
